title: Fix no HDMI sound after monitor turns off
summary: If HDMI audio stops working when the monitor turns off, disabling the switch-on-port-available module can prevent PulseAudio from incorrectly marking the output as unavailable.

steps.explain:
Find the line:
load-module module-switch-on-port-available
and add a # at the beginning to comment it out:
#load-module module-switch-on-port-available
Restart PulseAudio to apply the change.

rollback.explain: Uncomment the line in default.pa and restart PulseAudio.

warnings: Disabling this module may prevent automatic switching between audio outputs (e.g., headphones vs speakers).
